svg.text: Reserve with gRPC, hand off with Kafka + transactional outbox, finalize on payment, compensate on expiry
Phase 1 - Reserve quota and seats (synchronous, gRPC)
Transactional outbox: the order and its event
commit atomically, so no event is lost or
Phase 2 - Outbox drain to Kafka (CloudEvents envelope)
UPDATE payments SET status=SUCCEEDED AND INSERT
Phase 4 - Finalize quota and complete the order
UPDATE orders SET status=CONFIRMED AND outbox
ALT AWAITING_PAYMENT and still inside the payment grace
Not expired yet: a charge may be in flight. The
order stays open for the payment grace past
default 45, at most 45). Nothing re-sends the
event, so the order is expired once the grace
has passed, by OrderExpirySweepJob or on the
ALT order still PENDING or AWAITING_PAYMENT, and past any grace

Every consumer failure retries with exponential back-off (max 3), then routes to <topic>.dlq. Messages are audited and never silently dropped. The saga has no distributed lock: quota and seats are held with a TTL, finalized only after payment succeeds, and released by the expiration timer otherwise.
